region: Newcomb, San Juan County, northwestern New Mexico, Navajo Nation

authoritativeEvidence.source: Navajo Nation Office of the President and Vice President
authoritativeEvidence.finding: Navajo Police responded at approximately 00:30 local time to people swept away by floodwaters near Newcomb; two adults and one juvenile died.

impacts.response: Navajo Police Department Shiprock District, Navajo Nation Fire and Rescue, Navajo EMS and search-and-rescue resources responded.

forecastComparison.reason: No frozen outlook-ledger entry matching Newcomb/San Juan County flash flooding before the 2026-09-16 00:30 MDT event onset was found. New Mexico flood-warning-derived outlooks visible in the ledger concern Chaves/Lincoln counties and use later 17 September warning evidence; they cannot be expanded retrospectively to Newcomb or credited for this earlier event.

coverageReason: The repository still has no immutable scan ledger sufficient to prove whether Newcomb/San Juan County was scanned before onset. Therefore this false negative cannot honestly be subclassified as SCANNED_BUT_NOT_FORECAST or NOT_SCANNED/COVERAGE_FAILURE.
materialChange: New significant observed disaster and false negative established. This event was not present in verification-ledger.json or prior audit-update search results at audit time.
